question: Why is food prepared by an uninitiated person unfit to be offered to the Lord?
premises: Offerings to the Lord require proper qualification.
Food prepared by such a person is not fit.
That food indeed does not deserve to be offered to the Lord.
inference: Unqualified preparation renders food unacceptable as an offering to the Lord.
plain_english: Indeed, that cooked food does not deserve to be offered to me.
